t: This is 1 Palace Green, a Grade II star listed house in Kensington. It was designed by Philip Webb, often called the Father of Arts and Crafts Architecture, and completed in 1870, with additions in 1874. The interiors were decorated by Morris, Marshall, Faulkner and Company. George Howard, later the ninth Earl of Carlisle, commissioned it. He was an aristocrat, politician and painter, and the last Earl of Carlisle to own Castle Howard. Webb also co-founded the Society for the Protection of Ancient Buildings.
